subject: Re: Redwood security & subprocessors — next steps

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood security & subprocessors — next steps

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II audit in 2025; we can share the report once we have a confidentiality agreement in place.
- Data residency & GDPR/HIPAA: For your EU and PHI workloads we support VPC/private deployments and customer-managed keys; we discussed encryption-at-rest and separation of PHI in dedicated pools.
- Subprocessors: You asked for our current subprocessor list (cloud infra, observability, monitoring, etc.) — I can share the latest export and a brief risk summary.

Proposed next steps:
1) I will send the subprocessor list and SOC2 stub attachments by EOD tomorrow.
2) If you want to run your vendor security questionnaire (VSQ), send over the doc or a link and we’ll triage responses; typical turnaround is 3–5 business days for standard questionnaires.
3) If you prefer, we can schedule a short call between your security lead and Vivek to go over details.

Attached: Redwood_Subprocessors_v2.pdf (stub), SOC2-Type-II-Report-2025.pdf (stub)

Let me know if you'd like the SOC 2 sent to a secure link or if there is an NDA we should sign first.

Thanks,

Marissa
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acmecorp.com>

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap. Aisha (our security lead) is copied; she'll coordinate the VSQ. Two quick asks on our side:

1) We need a breakdown of which subprocessors handle customer content vs telemetry/metrics.
2) For SOC 2, can you confirm whether the report includes cloud vendor attestations (e.g., AWS controls) or if that's redacted?

We can share our VSQ (it's a 120-question Doc) — would you prefer a spreadsheet or a DocuSign-style intake form?

-Jordan
Director of IT, Acme Corp
jordan.ellis@acmecorp.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood security & subprocessors — next steps

Jordan/Aisha —

Attached are the subprocessor export and the SOC 2 report stub. Notes inline:

- Subprocessors file includes a "data_scope" column that indicates whether a subprocessor processes customer content, metadata/telemetry, or is for platform operations only. See rows for AWS, GCP, Datadog, Sentry, and our tokenization vendor.
- SOC 2: The report includes our auditor's assessment; vendor attestations from cloud providers are summarized but some vendor-specific evidence is redacted per vendor policy. If you need full cloud vendor evidence we can coordinate a vendor-supplied attestation separately.

Attachments:
- Redwood_Subprocessors_v2.pdf (export; includes data_scope and processing locations)
- SOC2-Type-II-Report-2025.pdf (redacted vendor attachments; available under NDA)

Questionnaire: we can accept your VSQ in spreadsheet form (xlsx) or a shared Google Doc. For large questionnaires we often run a parallel process: Rachel will own the intake and Vivek will handle technical follow-ups.

Proposed timeline: 3 business days to complete standard VSQ items; items requiring engineering evidence may take longer (5–10 business days).

Let us know preferred intake format and whether you want a walkthrough call this week.

Best,

Marissa
